caseName: Department of the Interior v. Klamath Water Users Protective Ass'n
caseNameFull: Department of the Interior v. Klamath Water Users Protective Assn.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certio-rari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, November 13, 2000. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, December 13, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 29, 2000. This Court's Rule 29.2 does not apply.
